notes:
Overview: Product org (CTO: Rafael Gomez, Head PM: Mina Patel) running POC to replace incumbent LLM API (moved after multiple latency regressions). Primary workload: customer-facing chat assistant with tool calls (search + ticket create).

Key timeline:
- 2026-02-12: Intro call with AE (Aisha) + SE (Marco). Goal: lower perceived chat latency; need streaming token-by-token and reliable function calls. Peak concurrent chats ~240 business hours.
- 2026-02-14: Hosted API demo (ff_2026-02-14_nova_intro_demo). Showed streaming + function-calls + progressive partial rendering. Engineering noted cleaner partial frames vs incumbent.
- 2026-02-18: Canary POC started (10% traffic). Tests: short-turn clarifications, multi-tool chains, high-concurrency soak.
- 2026-02-28: Internal measurement snapshot:
   * Incumbent provider: avg time-to-first-token 310ms; p95 first-token 640ms; observed 15-20% mid-session stalls at >=60 concurrent sessions. Tool-call overhead (search + webhook) 650-950ms.
   * Redwood hosted API: avg time-to-first-token 130ms; p95 first-token 210ms; mid-session stalls rare at 80 concurrent. Tool-call overhead 320-400ms (with search stub). Perceived UX: faster progressive UI updates.
- 2026-03-03: Soak test 150 concurrent for 2 hours (ff_2026-03-03_nova_benchmark_review). Redwood held p95 stability; incumbent produced intermittent 5xxs and longer tails.

Technical notes / preferences:
- SLO target: perceived start <200ms typical, p95 end-to-first-token goal <350ms for short-turn (<8 tokens) dialogs.
- Streaming: must be token-by-token with small chunk sizes for UI.
- Tool-calling: idempotent ticket create + search; need deterministic fallback if tool call timeouts.
- Cache: interested in KV/session caching to reduce retrieval calls.
- Models: prefer heterogenous/open models; plan to start on Redwood-curated then evaluate BYOM later.
- Routing: want policy-based fallback (smaller model) during capacity/cost spikes.
- Observability: token-level traces, per-route latency histograms, and streaming error metrics required.

Commercial/Procurement:
- Short-term: Hosted API to replace incumbent and GA quickly. Mid-term: move to Dedicated (3-node reserved) for predictable latency and capacity. Region preference: na-west.
- Pricing asks: committed discount at 12mo; ramp schedule and overage rules. Clarify billing granularity for streaming + function calls.

Open actions / blockers:
- Legal requires explicit non-training clause & KMS integration details (Drive doc submitted).
- Product asks for hard SLA on p95 streaming latency before finalizing Dedicated sizing.
- Finance needs ARR band approval for 12mo commit.
